title: GetCommandStatusResponse
description: Response object for get command status.

success.description: Whether the diagnostic collection is successful.

active.description: Whether the command is still active.

startTime.description: Start time of the CM command.

endTime.description: End time of the CM command.

resultDataUrl.description: Some commands have result data URL for downloading the diagnostic bundle. On certain CM versions the bundle download is only available through this URL, but not with download-diagnostic-bundle operation.

bundleStatus.description: The current status of the command.

bundleStatusMessage.description: Further information about the current command status.
